dex.text: Hides your keys, curdles the milk and blames the cat. Whatever you do, don't give it a name. It takes that as an invitation.
dex.fact: In Pennine folklore a boggart is a household spirit that turns from mischief to real malice once it is given a name, after which it can be neither reasoned with nor got rid of.

dex.text: A farmer once flitted house to get shot of one. A neighbour asked if they were moving, and a voice from the milk churn said "Aye, we're flitting!" They turned the cart round.
dex.fact: Boggart Hole Clough, a wooded ravine and park in Blackley in north Manchester, takes its name from the boggart said to haunt it.
